---
title: "Data Infrastructure"
sidebarTitle: "Overview"
description: "The engines that get your data in and shape it: Airhouse, Airway, and Airform"
---

Data Infrastructure is the foundation of Oxygen, getting your data in and
shaping it into clean tables that your [World Model](/guide/build/world-model)
and agents can query. Three engines do the work.

<CardGroup cols={3}>
  <Card title="Airhouse" icon="warehouse" href="/guide/build/data-infrastructure/airhouse">
    The managed warehouse where your data lands, with ephemeral credentials
    and no long-lived key to rotate.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Airway" icon="arrow-right-to-bracket" href="/guide/build/data-infrastructure/airway">
    ELT pipelines that extract data from external systems and load it into
    your warehouse.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Airform" icon="diagram-project" href="/guide/build/data-infrastructure/airform">
    dbt-style modeling, with version-controlled SQL transforms that land
    clean, tested tables. Open source.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

## How they fit together

<Steps>
  <Step title="Load">
    **[Airway](/guide/build/data-infrastructure/airway)** pipelines extract
    data from your source systems and load it into
    **[Airhouse](/guide/build/data-infrastructure/airhouse)**, or into your
    own warehouse.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Shape">
    **[Airform](/guide/build/data-infrastructure/airform)** models the raw
    tables into clean, tested ones.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Model">
    The [World Model](/guide/build/world-model) defines your measures over
    those tables and compiles them into correct SQL for agents and apps.
  </Step>
</Steps>
